title: Physics-Informed Foresight Pruning for Sparse PINN Solvers of Nonlinear PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2608.25564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often rely on over-parameterized models to optimize coupled solution and differential-residual objectives, leaving unclear how much capacity is necessary and what pruning should preserve. We study foresight pruning at initialization for sparse PirateNet PDE solvers. Standard neural tangent kernel spectrum-aware pruning (NTK-SAP) aims to preserve output-side training dynamics but may overlook parameters whose main influence arises through derivatives in the governing equations. We introduce physics-informed spectrum-aware pruning (PI-SAP), which assigns saliency using sensitivity of the PDE residual. Experiments on the Gray-Scott equations, complex Ginzburg-Landau equation, Burgers' equation, and linear convection equation show that PI-SAP more consistently preserves Gray-Scott residual fidelity and is competitive under aggressive sparsity. However, no criterion is uniformly optimal across equation

translated_title: 面向非线性PDE稀疏PINN求解器的物理信息前瞻剪枝方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25564v1 公告类型：新  摘要：物理信息神经网络（PINN）通常依赖过参数化模型来优化耦合的求解和微分残差目标，这使得所需容量大小以及剪枝应保留什么变得不明确。我们研究了在初始化阶段对稀疏PirateNet偏微分方程求解器进行前瞻剪枝的方法。标准的神经正切核谱感知剪枝（NTK-SAP）旨在保留输出侧的训练动态，但可能忽略那些主要通过控制方程中的导数产生影响的参数。我们引入了物理信息谱感知剪枝（PI-SAP），该方法利用PDE残差的敏感性来分配显著性。在Gray-Scott方程、复Ginzburg-Landau方程、Burgers方程和线性对流方程上的实验表明，PI-SAP在保留Gray-Scott残差保真度方面更为一致，并且在高度稀疏条件下具有竞争力。然而，没有任何标准在所有方程中都是统一最优的。
tldr: 提出了一种新的物理信息谱感知剪枝方法（PI-SAP），通过PDE残差敏感性分配显著性，在稀疏条件下更有效地保持Gray-Scott等方程的残差保真度，但并非所有方程下都最优。
en_tdlr: A novel physics-informed spectrum-aware pruning method (PI-SAP) assigns saliency via PDE residual sensitivity, more consistently preserving Gray-Scott residual fidelity under sparsity, though not uniformly optimal across all equations.
